From 3e1ad196385c65c1454aceab1226d9a4baca27d5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>
Date: Tue, 3 May 2022 17:35:25 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] btrfs: sysfs: export the balance paused state of exclusive
 operation

The new state allowing device addition with paused balance is not
exported to user space so it can't recognize it and actually start the
operation.

Fixes: efc0e69c2fea ("btrfs: introduce exclusive operation BALANCE_PAUSED state")
CC: stable@vger.kernel.org # 5.17
Signed-off-by: David Sterba <dsterba@suse.com>

diff --git a/fs/btrfs/sysfs.c b/fs/btrfs/sysfs.c
index 17389a42a3ab..ba78ca5aabbb 100644
--- a/fs/btrfs/sysfs.c
+++ b/fs/btrfs/sysfs.c
@@ -922,6 +922,9 @@ static ssize_t btrfs_exclusive_operation_show(struct kobject *kobj,
 		case BTRFS_EXCLOP_BALANCE:
 			str = "balance\n";
 			break;
+		case BTRFS_EXCLOP_BALANCE_PAUSED:
+			str = "balance paused\n";
+			break;
 		case BTRFS_EXCLOP_DEV_ADD:
 			str = "device add\n";
 			break;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/btrfs/sysfs.c`**
   - A new case has been added to the `btrfs_exclusive_operation_show` function to handle the `BTRFS_EXCLOP_BALANCE_PAUSED` state.
   - When this state is encountered, the string "balance paused\n" is returned, allowing the user space to recognize the paused state of the balance operation.

### Relationships
The modification in `fs/btrfs/sysfs.c` addresses a bug where the new state `BTRFS_EXCLOP_BALANCE_PAUSED` was not previously exported to user space. By adding this case, the patch ensures that user space can now correctly identify when a balance operation is paused, enabling it to initiate device addition while the balance is paused. This change is directly related to the introduction of the exclusive operation BALANCE_PAUSED state, as referenced in the commit message.
